title: Peer-Voted LLM-Agent Stress Tests Find Feed-Induced Lexical Convergence but No Reliable Matched-Exposure Advantage for Distributed Sources
abstract: arXiv:2608.20438v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Population-level behavior in large-language-model (LLM) agents cannot be characterized by single-agent benchmarks. We introduce PV-SST, a peer-voted social-platform testbed, and report a separately frozen, preregistered matched-exposure experiment spanning four topics, four unused seeds, four open-weight model families, and three prespecified larger variants. The experiment comprises 448 trials and 112 complete model-by-topic-by-seed blocks. Relative to a topic-only control, a feed of previous-round peer posts ranked by peer-generated likes increases final-round lexical similarity in both the four-family core panel (paired mean difference +0.0082 TF-IDF cosine units, 95% block-bootstrap CI [0.0043, 0.0121], randomization p=0.000105, n=64 blocks) and the three-variant size extension (+0.0109 [0.0069, 0.0151], p=0.000001, n=48). This contrast bundles peer-post exposure with ranking and therefore does not identify a ranking-only effect. O

translated_title: 同行投票的大语言模型智能体压力测试发现反馈引发的词汇趋同，但分布式来源在匹配暴露下无可靠优势
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体的群体级行为无法通过单智能体基准来表征。我们引入了PV-SST，一个同行投票的社交平台测试环境，并报告了一项预先冻结、预注册的匹配暴露实验，涵盖四个主题、四个未使用种子、四个开放权重模型家族和三个预先指定的大型变体。该实验包含448次试验和112个完整的模型-主题-种子块。相对于仅主题对照组，由同行生成的点赞排序的上一轮同行帖子反馈，在四家族核心面板中增加了最终轮词汇相似性（配对平均差异+0.0082 TF-IDF余弦单位，95%块自举置信区间[0.0043, 0.0121]，随机化p=0.000105，n=64块），并在三变体规模扩展中也如此（+0.0109 [0.0069, 0.0151]，p=0.000001，n=48）。这种对比将同行帖子暴露与排序捆绑在一起，因此无法识别仅排序效应。
tldr: 该论文通过同行投票的社交平台测试环境PV-SST，证明同行反馈（帖子及其点赞排序）显著增强了LLM智能体的词汇趋同，但无法分离出排序的独立效应。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PV-SST, a peer-voted social-platform testbed, demonstrating that peer feedback (posts with like-based ranking) significantly increases lexical convergence in LLM agents, but cannot isolate a ranking-only effect.
